claims: Antigravity added Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5
Free and Plus users cannot use Gemini Pro in Antigravity anymore

On-screen availability table: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Thinking) and Claude Opus 5.5 (Thinking) are X for Free and Google AI Plus, available on AI Pro (with asterisk) and AI Ultra, X for Enterprise; Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Opus 4.6 remain available on lower tiers; GPT-OSS-120B available on most tiers
Gemini plan table: Free gets Flash-Lite only; AI Plus gets Flash-Lite + Flash; AI Pro and AI Ultra get Flash-Lite, Flash and Pro

cta: Asks what viewers think about the changes to Antigravity and Google

relevance.why: Haji already pays for Claude; Antigravity is interesting only as a second IDE with free-tier access, and that free tier is now shrinking. Model-availability trivia, not a workflow change.

implement_score.why: Nothing to do unless Haji wants Antigravity as a Claude 5.5 backup, which requires a Google AI Pro subscription on top of his Anthropic plan.

verify: Confirm the exact tier gating of Claude 5.5 models in Antigravity and what the Pro asterisk means (rate limits?)
Is Gemini Pro truly removed for Free/Plus or just rate-limited?
Is this a 21-second stitch of a longer video; the transcript only captures the ending

gap.what: New warning: Antigravity's free tier is being tightened (Gemini Pro removed for Free/Plus; Claude 5.5 only on Pro/Ultra). The liked set covered Antigravity as a 'free Google tool' without this gating.
